issue.title: Sentry integration causing Quarkus to fail at start in dev mode
issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
When following the steps of the [Quarkus Sentry logging guide](https://quarkus.io/guides/logging-sentry), the application fails to start.

**Expected behavior**
Quarkus starts up normally and Sentry integration works as described in the guide and as was behavior before about Quarkus version 1.9.1.Final

**Actual behavior**
An exception is thrown, Quarkus fails to startup:

```
./mvnw compile quarkus:dev
[...]

Dez. 27, 2020 12:58:33 PM io.quarkus.runtime.ApplicationLifecycleManager run
ERROR: Failed to start application (with profile dev)
java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonGenerator

        at io.sentry.SentryClientFactory.createClient(SentryClientFactory.java:178)
        at io.sentry.Sentry.init(Sentry.java:138)
        at io.quarkus.logging.sentry.SentryHandlerValueFactory.create(SentryHandlerValueFactory.java:40)
        at io.quarkus.deployment.steps.SentryProcessor$addSentryLogHandler-1613402751.deploy_0(SentryProcessor$addSentryLogHandler-1613402751.zig:80)
        at io.quarkus.deployment.steps.SentryProcessor$addSentryLogHandler-1613402751.deploy(SentryProcessor$addSentryLogHandler-1613402751.zig:40)
        at io.quarkus.runner.ApplicationImpl.doStart(ApplicationImpl.zig:477)

```

**To Reproduce**

Reproducer project attached:
[getting-started.zip](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/files/5744529/getting-started.zip)

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. `mvn io.quarkus:quarkus-maven-plugin:1.10.5.Final:create     -DprojectGroupId=org.acme     -DprojectArtifactId=getting-started     -DclassName="org.acme.getting.started.GreetingResource"     -Dpath="/hello"`
2. `cd getting-started/`
3. `./mvnw quarkus:add-extension -Dextensions="logging-sentry"`
4. `echo "quarkus.log.sentry=true" >> src/main/resources/application.properties`
5. `echo "quarkus.log.sentry.dsn=https://c8ddd5f8988545ab95d1d9a815fc508c@o367630.ingest.sentry.io/5571835" >> src/main/resources/application.properties`
6. `./mvnw compile quarkus:dev`

**Configuration**
```properties
# Add your application.properties here, if applicable.
quarkus.log.sentry=true
quarkus.log.sentry.dsn=https://c8ddd5f8988545ab95d1d9a815fc508c@o367630.ingest.sentry.io/5571835
```

**Additional context**
